title: The Accelerating Expanding Universe — Poorna Prajna School
teaser: Prof. Bharat Ratra (Kansas State University) spoke to about 350 high school students at Poorna Prajna School, Bengaluru, on 'The Accelerating Expanding Universe'.
homepageMatter: Prof. Bharat Ratra, Distinguished Professor of Physics at Kansas State University, spoke to about 350 high school students and teachers at Poorna Prajna School, Bengaluru, on 'The Accelerating Expanding Universe', using audio-visual presentations and simple physical models.
